findings.summary: Cancelled-with-zero-jobs instance WITH Git-timeline attribution (extends the signature family first distilled via runs/32894986672.json [unattributed] and runs/32864608446.json [attributed]): created 17:42:23Z by push 9ea00eb; sat queued ~4m33s with zero jobs; cancelled at 17:46:56Z — 3s AFTER run 7 (32879902647) was created at 17:46:55Z by the next cto push (1f4f573, 17:46:53Z).
